title: A1 Final Review Part 5: Prepositions & Adverbs
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has superado con éxito la quinta parte del Gran Repaso Final de A1.

parts.visual: Preposiciones de Tiempo y Lugar: IN (periodos largos, lugares cerrados), ON (días, fechas, superficies), AT (horas exactas, lugares/eventos específicos). Ej: in 2023, on Monday, at 5 PM. in London, on the desk, at the meeting.
parts.audio: Prepositions of time and place. IN for long periods and enclosed spaces. ON for days, dates, and surfaces. AT for exact times and specific places or events. For example: in 2023, on Monday, at 5 PM. Or in London, on the desk, and at the meeting.

parts.visual: Adverbios de Frecuencia: always (siempre), usually (usualmente), sometimes (a veces), never (nunca). Van ANTES del verbo principal (I always work) pero DESPUÉS del verbo To Be (I am always busy). Adverbios de Modo: quickly, carefully, well, hard.
parts.audio: Adverbs of frequency: always, usually, sometimes, never. They go BEFORE the main verb, like I always work. But AFTER the verb To Be, like I am always busy. Adverbs of manner: quickly, carefully, well, and hard.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la preposición o el adverbio correcto.

questions.question: The manager is ____ the meeting room. (Adentro).
Someone is waiting ____ the reception.
questions.explanation: Puntos específicos en un edificio llevan 'at'.

questions.question: I am ____ late for work. (Nunca llego tarde).
questions.explanation: El adverbio va después de 'am': I am never late.

questions.question: She ____ checks her emails in the morning. (Siempre).
questions.explanation: El adverbio va antes del verbo principal: always checks.

questions.question: We ____ go out for lunch on Fridays. (A veces).
He works very ____. (Rápido).
questions.explanation: 'Fast' es un adverbio irregular, no existe 'fastly'.

questions.question: Please read the document ____. (Cuidadosamente).
questions.explanation: Adverbio de modo terminado en -ly: carefully.

questions.question: The team worked ____ to finish the project. (Duro).
questions.explanation: El adverbio es 'hard' (hardly significa casi nunca).

questions.question: The IT department is ____ the third floor.
I am ____ home today. (Trabajando en casa).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la preposición (in, on, at) o el adverbio correcto.

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The report is on the table.
options: The report is on the table.
The report is on the desk.
The folder is on the table.
The report is in the table.
questions.correct_answer: The report is on the table.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The manager is in the meeting room.
options: The manager is in the meeting room.
The manager is at the meeting room.
The boss is in the meeting room.
The manager is in the office.
questions.correct_answer: The manager is in the meeting room.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Someone is waiting at the reception.
options: Someone is waiting at the reception.
Someone is waiting in the reception.
He is waiting at the reception.
questions.correct_answer: Someone is waiting at the reception.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am never late for work.
options: I am never late for work.
I am always late for work.
He is never late for work.
questions.correct_answer: I am never late for work.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: She always checks her emails in the morning.
options: She always checks her emails in the morning.
He always checks his emails in the morning.
She never checks her emails in the morning.
She always reads her emails in the morning.
questions.correct_answer: She always checks her emails in the morning.
